newsletter_capability_detail: Searched bombora.com/intent-data/, bombora.com/all-partners/ and developer.bombora.com for newsletter, email and subscription-content sourcing. Sources are described as media destinations and B2B websites with topic-level research behavior: "Across the Co-op we track tens of thousands of topics (updated frequently) and millions of B2B domains." Newsletters are not named as a source type.
verified_gap: Newsletter topic activity is not documented as a Co-op input; the Co-op is described in website/domain terms. Because membership is described broadly as "media destinations (publishers, B2B brands, and premium data providers)", newsletter publishers may already contribute indirectly via their web archives.

likely_buyer_role: VP Data Partnerships / GM Data Solutions (Co-op sourcing and data licensing)

contact_route.note: Public partner-ecosystem inquiry ('Become a partner') is the only route found; contact page returned bot-blocked and no named data-partnership contact or public email was retrievable.

caveats: The Co-op already includes publishers, so the honest framing is a data-licensing conversation - does newsletter open/mention data add topic coverage their web signals miss - not a capability gap claim. Bombora is also a supplier to 6sense, so approaching both risks channel conflict. Their docs are marketing-level; a definitive answer needs a direct data-co-op conversation.
